integrity: The displayed elimination is an algebraic proof, supported by standalone exact arithmetic. The computations over four finite fields are additional checks, not a proof for arbitrary extension degree. No independent audit or validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Counts apply to fixed-coordinate monic cubic presentations over finite fields, not isomorphism classes or twists. The zero-shift superspecial branch and the general Howe decomposition are prior art; the only claimed new component is the explicit nonzero-shift ten-point a-number-three locus, factor degrees, and marked census. No individual full zeta functions are given; possible unindexed prior arithmetic computations remain a novelty risk.
title: The ten non-superspecial points in the characteristic-five supersingular Howe parameter locus
